limits: No physical Linux speaker/phone acceptance here; owner friend retest on Ubuntu required. No guarantee for every distro, GNOME/KDE compositor or GPU.
Wayland requires XWayland; glibc, PulseAudio or pipewire-pulse required. Alpine/musl and native PipeWire-only sessions are not supported by these artifacts.
A newly started app explicitly pinned to a physical output can sound briefly until routing event handling; explicit manual reroutes are respected.
Safe automatic installers not implemented. Future options: signed Sparkle updates, signed MSIX/AppInstaller, signed apt repository or Flatpak.
